name: Context Menu
description: Floating right-click context menu with singleton pattern. Renders a positioned overlay with items (label + action), separators, and disabled items. Auto-closes on outside click or item selection. Closes all prior open menus before creating a new one (tracks via static openMenus array). Supports onClose callback.

types.name: ContextMenuItem
types.definition: { label?: string; action?: () => void; disabled?: boolean; separator?: boolean }

interface.constructor: new ContextMenu(items: ContextMenuItem[], x: number, y: number)

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Hide and cleanup: remove document listener, splice from static array, call onClose

static.name: openMenus
static.description: Tracks all active menus for singleton enforcement

interactions.action: remove() via document click listener (setTimeout 0 deferred)
All existing menus in openMenus are removed first
